chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: Her parents' pride and open house at Derby time
summary: Her parents were proud but sorry she was away so much, and visited her. Each Derby time the family home held open house for people from everywhere.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Well listen, I meant to ask you earlier on, your parents of course, they always
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
looked forward to seeing you come Derby time.
But they must have been sorry, I mean, proud of you making a career but sorry to see you away from home so much.
Oh yes. They were sorry I was away from home so much but then they would come and visit with me.
Oh, well that was nice. And you said you'd tell many people to go look your parents up?
Yeah. See we'd have 'open house' come Derby time, and everybody from everywhere, they'd all stop at our home.
